detail.longDescription: Also though, good on Canada and our government for doing this: “More than three-fourths of the 64 professors who are moving to Canada from around the world will come from the US. Under a new government programme, they'll receive funding from a pool of C$504m ($362m; £268m) for research in fields such as climate change and medicine.” 🇨🇦 # Science # Research # LeadershipMatters # Canada
